pages.text: One of the basics to get better technology are metals. There are some natural metals on the overworld, like $(bold)copper$(), but aren't the more resistent. $(br)To get stronger metals like $(bold)iron$(), you will need something harder to mine it: $(bold)bronze$().
The alloy furnace is a block cappable of combine different materials utilizing heat. Is similar to normal furnaces, with the addition of another slot to add an extra material.
In order to make the alloy furnace, you'll need some bricks.
Then you have to craft at least $(bold)6 brick blocks$().
One you've got all the materials, combine $(bold)6 brick blocks$(), $(bold)3 cobblestone$() and an $(bold)adobe furnace$() to make your first $(bold)alloy furnace$().
